description: This file defines a class representing a comment node in an HTML purifier library, including properties for comment data and whitespace status, along with methods for construction and token conversion.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Node_Comment
classes.description: Represents a comment node within the HTML purifier, with properties for comment data and whitespace status, and a method to convert the node to a token pair.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new comment node with provided comment data, line, and column information.

methods.name: toTokenPair
methods.description: Converts the comment node into a token pair suitable for tokenization processes.
